sn42.10:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe || || 2
sn42.10:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena rājantepure rājaparisāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam antarākathā udapādi || ||
sn42.10:1.3: Kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūpajātaṃ || sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ || paṭigaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajatanti || || 3
sn42.10:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena Maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi tassam parisāyam nisinno hoti || || 4
sn42.10:2.2: Atha kho Maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi tam parisam etad avoca ||
sn42.10:2.4: na kappati samaṇānam sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ || na sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ || na paṭigaṇhanti samanā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ || nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā apetajātarūparajatā ti || ||
sn42.10:2.5: Asakkhi kho Maṇicūlako gāmaṇi tam parisaṃ saññāpetuṃ || || 5
sn42.10:2.6: Atha kho Maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi || || 6 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn42.10:2.7: Idha bhante rājantepure rājaparisāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānam ayam antarākathā udapādi || ||
sn42.10:2.8: Kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jatarūparajataṃ || sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ || paṭigaṇhantisamaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajatanti || ||
sn42.10:2.9: Evaṃvutte aham bhante tam parisam etad avoca ||
sn42.10:2.11: na kappati samaṇānam sakyaputtiyānam jātarūparajataṃ || na sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ || na patigaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ || nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā apetajātarūparajatā ti || ||
sn42.10:2.12: Asakkhim khvāham bhante tam parisaṃ saññāpetuṃ || || 7
sn42.10:2.13: Kaccāham bhante evam vyākaramāno vuttavādī ceva Bhagavato homi || na ca Bhagavantam abhūtena abbhācikkhāmi || dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyakāromi na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānam āgacchatī ti ||
sn42.10:3.1: Taggha tvam gāmaṇi evam vyākaramāno vuttvavādī ceva me hosi na ca mam abhūtena abbhācikkhasi || dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākarosi na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo garayham ṭhānam āgacchati || || 8
sn42.10:3.2: Na hi gāmaṇi kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ || na sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ || na paṭigaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jatarūparajataṃ || na paṭigaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ || nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā apetajātarūparajatā || ||
sn42.10:3.3: Yassa kho gāmaṇi jātarūparajataṃ kappati pañca pi tassa kāmaguṇā kappanti ||
sn42.10:3.4: yassa pañca kāmaguṇā kappanti ekaṃsenetaṃ gāmaṇi dhāreyyāsi asamaṇadhammo asakyaputtiyadhammoti || || 9
sn42.10:3.6: Tiṇaṃ tiṇatthikena pariyesitabbaṃ || dāruṃ dārutthikena pariyesitabbam || sakaṭaṃ sakaṭatthikena pariyesitabbam || puriso purisatthikena pariyesitabbo ||
sn42.10:3.7: na tvevāhaṃ gāmaṇi kenaci pariyāyena jātarūparajataṃ sāditabbam pariyesitabban ti vadāmī
